immutable_note: Do not edit this file after the first treatment run. Changing thresholds after seeing results invalidates certification.

arms.baseline: core review pipeline only (no treatment plugin / prompt set)
arms.treatment: identical settings plus the treatment under test

baseline_protocol.note: Phase 2 live grid predated unsupported-claim and suggestion-compile rates. Before the first treatment run, record a control baseline with those Phase 4 rates at the same provider/model/context/strictness, three repetitions. Freeze that baseline snapshot; do not retune the gate to it.

metric_definitions.unsupported_claim_rate: evals SpecialistAggregate / corpus unsupported-claim rate (findings with ≥1 unresolvable worktree ref / findings checked)
metric_definitions.suggestion_breakage_rate: 1 - suggestion-compile rate among surviving suggestions with a runnable toolchain (tool_missing excluded from denominator)
metric_definitions.recall_original_12: labelled must-appear recall restricted to original_12_case_ids
metric_definitions.token_count: corpus total input+output tokens (or input tokens if output unavailable); compare treatment mean to baseline mean

outcome_rules.measured-helpful: All gate predicates pass for the pinned model at context_length, with CI excluding zero on the unsupported-claim delta across three repetitions.
outcome_rules.measured-no-uplift: A live baseline and treatment were run and at least one gate predicate failed. Record as-is; do not retune the gate.
outcome_rules.pending: No usable live model run (provider down, model missing, or baseline snapshot absent). No uplift claim may be made.
